adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies legacy SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts lines directly into the embeddable_hosts table via raw SQL: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` without running the EmbeddableHost model’s `before_validation` normalization (which strips `http(s)://` and paths) or escaping/whitespace trimming. Later, host checks use `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` → `uri.host` (e.g. `example.com`) and query `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. If the migrated row stored `http://example.com` or contains `\r`/spaces, it will not match `example.com`, so previously allowed entries can become disallowed after upgrade. The lack of SQL escaping also risks migration failure or SQL injection if the setting contains quotes.
